name: PpUpdateOption
description: Constants that specify how hyperlinks in presentaitons should be updated, passed to and returned by the AutoUpdate property of the LinkFormat object.

constants.name: ppUpdateOptionManual
constants.description: Link will be updated only when the user specifically asks to update the presentation.

constants.name: ppUpdateOptionAutomatic
constants.description: Link will be updated each time the presentation is opened or the source file changes.
